---
title: "Stores"
---

The Stores section lists every Store Release and its state: its Store Layout,
its Association Coverage, the Store Release Builds it went through, and what it
holds.

This page is a placeholder and is filled by #391. Until then the registry itself
is the record: one directory per Store Release under `stores/`, and
[`../STORES.md`](../STORES.md) is the generated index of them.
